summary: This family is the palace's own machine room — it is unusually self-aware, and several members talk about each other's open questions without knowing it. Read together, the room shows genuine progress hiding as scatter: Two Batons, One Board has quietly resolved most of what it set out to answer (the scheduled poller is Palace Orchestrator, the digest is built) and its own forward vector already asks to dissolve into Project Stewardship System — that's the clearest de-sprawl move here, not a forced one. A cluster of load-bearing organs (Concierge, Pheromone Trail, BBS Design System) sit at stage "sprout" despite carrying nine-to-eleven inbound links and recent activation — the stage label looks stale next to the weight these entries actually carry. Two live open questions resolve against siblings already in the room: Enchanted Worker's question about page-agents comparing context windows directly is exactly what Dialogue Moderator does, and Project Stewardship System's question about whether it needs a four-pillar agency_profile is already answered by example in Dialogue Moderator's frontmatter. And one clean unsung path: Dialogue Moderator names "the palace citizen test" and "citizenship responsibility" in its own prose with no link to the newcomer [[Making a Palace Citizen]] — a genuine miss, not a stretch.

Project Stewardship System already `deepens` it with label 'names-the-bandwidth-frontier'.
